context: Daichi and Mei bring baby Hikari to visit. Sho and Hina play with the baby.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひな、しょう、ひかりちゃん、来たよ。
lines.style: Warm, bright opening. Soft announcement with genuine delight underneath. The pride of bringing someone loved into the room audible but not performed. Steady, gentle pace.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: やったー！ひかりちゃん、可愛い！
lines.style: Pure, unbridled eight-year-old excitement. Quick attack on the opening syllable. High, sun-bright tone throughout. No restraint — this is genuine, unfiltered delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: こんにちは、ひかりちゃん。
lines.style: Quiet, careful six-year-old politeness. Soft opening. The words carry weight — this greeting matters. Gentle pace, genuine warmth threading underneath the formal courtesy.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ひかり、いっぱい、お姉さん、お兄さん、おるな。
lines.en: Hikari's got a whole crew of big sisters and brothers now.
lines.style: Kansai lilt and warmth woven through. Generous, affectionate observation. Gentle philosophical tone — noticing and celebrating the fullness of the moment. Slight musical swing on the phrasing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Hina's really good at holding her!
lines.style: Bright, proud eight-year-old. Quick, eager delivery. Offering herself up as helper with unselfconscious confidence. Warm tone, no false modesty — just genuine belief in her own kindness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hehe, please be gentle with her.
lines.style: Soft, warm laugh. Tender request that isn't quite a command. Trusting the children completely but also protective. Gentle cadence — the warmth of someone who means what they say and knows they're heard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Let's watch together, nice and gentle.
lines.style: Small voice, but steady with purpose. Quiet invitation more than direction. Six-year-old kindness that knows its own strength. Slow, deliberate pace. Warmth and care in every syllable.
